summary: JSON tokenizer and recursive-descent parser over caller buffers, six releases (0.1 to 1.0): a serializer and path lookup, three security fixes (nesting limit, escape/writer overflows, integer overflow), a rename/move/split/merge refactor, a word-at-a-time string scanner, constant tuning and a tidy-up.

pairs.intent: Security hardening: bounds-check UTF-8 encoding and \u escapes, join surrogate pairs, reject control characters and invalid UTF-8, detect integer overflow, fix two serializer overflows.

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: takes the output capacity and returns 0 when the encoding does not fit or the code point is a surrogate or above U+10FFFF (previously always wrote up to 4 bytes)

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: passes the remaining capacity to json_utf8_encode (fixes a 1-3 byte heap overflow on \uXXXX) and combines surrogate pairs; lone surrogates become U+FFFD

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: accumulates in uint64_t and returns JSON_ERR_RANGE before the value overflows (signed overflow was undefined behaviour)

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: mantissa, fraction scale and exponent are range checked

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: rejects raw control characters and validates non-ASCII bytes through the new json_utf8_seq_len

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: computes the bytes each escape needs (up to 6 for \u00XX) instead of checking for 2, which overflowed the caller buffer

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: refuses to open more containers than the 32-bit bit stack can track (shift by >= 32 was undefined and corrupted state)

truth.label: changed

truth.label: changed
